record_notes.record: Two-qubit gate error on the run’s two pairs
record_notes.ibm_doc: “The QPU-reported properties are updated once a day, but the system may drift faster than the time between updates.”
record_notes.shows: Stated 0.00414 and 0.0025. Measured 0.003 to 0.00345 and 0.00172 to 0.00203: 0.69 to 0.83 times the stated figure. The record was off in the other direction.

record_notes.record: Two-qubit gate error on the run’s two pairs
record_notes.shows: Stated 0.0168 and 0.002. Measured 0.0159 to 0.0199 and 0.00113 to 0.00247. The layout the record picks carries a pair with about eight times the error of its neighbor.

record_notes.record: Two-qubit gate error on the run’s two pairs
record_notes.shows: Stated 0.00115 and 0.00103. Measured the same session 0.00172 to 0.0018 and 0.0015 to 0.00255: 1.45 to 2.47 times the stated figure.

effects.effect: A fade term in the price fit
effects.ibm_states: Gate error measured on the run’s own pairs minutes before the main job
effects.delivered: Applied in the analysis only. The circuit, layout and shots are the client’s, unchanged.
effects.how: Both arms read the same shots, so the gap is the fit, not luck of the draw.

effects.effect: How strongly the fade is weighted, per chip
effects.delivered: fez 1.35 · marrakesh 1.50 · kingston 0.63. Frozen before the run; nothing was fitted on these shots.
effects.how: On marrakesh the weight sits at the edge of the range searched: that layout carries more than a fade term absorbs, which is where the 4.3 % left over sits.

effects.effect: Against a client who already corrects with IBM’s stated gate error
effects.ibm_states: The same fade term, at the stated figure
effects.delivered: fez: better in run 2, the same within ±0.04 in run 1. marrakesh: better in run 1, worse by 0.012 to 0.016 in run 2. kingston: ours better in both runs.
effects.how: Where the record is right, using it gets close. The check tells you which day that is.

method: Method: the client’s own amplitude-estimation circuit, layout and shots, run twice on each processor as 32 interleaved copies, 19 November 2026. Their arm fits with no noise term; ours adds a fade term from gate error measured on the chip in the same session. Error is the absolute gap to the exact price, 8.2543. Intervals are 99 %. Job records for every run: quantumidleaudit.com/demo-finance.
